$comment: S5 component manifest (Build Order Step 11). A component is a registered human capability: HTML partial + optional CSS + this manifest. Copy-on-insert expands component.html into a page's canonical HTML once; the component then stops existing as an abstraction (no component JSON as page state).
name: card
description: A simple content card: eyebrow, title, body, and a primary call-to-action link. Uses the shared .card / .btn design-system vocabulary; its editable slots (title, body, cta) are declared so an inserted card is immediately editable in the S5 editor.
